published.source: DatabaseDiagnostics|More than one schema in the search path contains GitLab objects: %{schemas}. GitLab's objects should all live in a single schema. When they are split across multiple schemas, unqualified references can resolve unexpectedly.

published.source: DatabaseDiagnostics|More than one schema in the search path contains objects: %{schemas}. This can be intentional, but unqualified references resolve against the first match, so objects spread across schemas can resolve unexpectedly.
published.translation: DatabaseDiagnostics|Fler än ett schema i sökvägen innehåller objekt: %{schemas}. Detta kan vara avsiktligt, men okvalificerade referenser löses mot den första träffen, så objekt som är spridda över scheman kan lösas oväntat.
